title: Getting started with Kaderblick | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Getting started with Kaderblick
hero.lead: From opening the website to your personal workspace: use an account, understand assignments, navigate the application and check the first settings.

body:
On this page

  • Open Kaderblick
  • Sign in or register
  • Complete your assignment
  • Use navigation
  • Check your profile
  • Resolve initial problems

1. Open Kaderblick

  1. 1
    Open the website
    Open the Kaderblick address provided by your club in a current browser.
  2. 2
    Choose your cookie settings
    In the cookie notice, select Necessary only, open Cookie settings or consent with Accept all.
  3. 3
    Open sign-in
    Select Sign in in the top-right corner. On a small screen, the action is in the homepage header.

2. Sign in or create an account

Sign in with email and password

  1. Open the Sign in tab.
  2. Enter your complete email address.
  3. Enter your password.
  4. Select Log in.
  5. After successful sign-in, Kaderblick opens your personal dashboard.

Sign in with Google

Select Sign in with Google and follow the account selection in the Google window. Use the Google account that should be connected with your Kaderblick access.

Register a new account

  1. Open Register.
  2. Complete all required fields.
  3. Choose a password and repeat it in the confirmation field.
  4. Submit the registration.
  5. Open the confirmation message in your mailbox and follow its link.
  6. Then sign in with the confirmed account.
⚠️
No confirmation message received
Check the spam and junk folders and the spelling of the email address. Request the message again if it was not delivered or its link is no longer valid.

Use demo access

If the opened instance provides a demo catalogue, Show demo accounts appears in the sign-in dialog. Select a club and role. The credentials are placed in the fields; complete sign-in with Log in.

Choose a role and request a link

After registration, Kaderblick opens the link request automatically while the account has no person relation. You can later reopen it through User account → Request link. On a phone, each stage occupies its own screen so the search field, results and navigation remain visible.

  1. Choose person type: select player or coach.
  2. Search for a team: enter at least two characters and select a result. The browser does not preload the complete team list. Results show team name, age group and club.
  3. Search for a person: enter at least two name characters. The backend searches only players or coaches assigned to the selected team and limits that filtered result set.
  4. State the relation: choose your relation and optionally add a note.
  5. Review: verify type, team, person, relation and note. Only Submit request sends it to an administrator.

If you cannot find the team or person, change the query or contact the responsible club administrator. Staff and official team or club functions are assigned separately by administrators.

4. Navigate Kaderblick

Desktop and larger screens

  • The main navigation is on the left.
  • Dashboard and Calendar open personal overviews directly.
  • Areas such as Matches, Team & Club and Community group related pages.
  • Additional sections such as Coach, Supporter or Administration only appear with a matching assignment.
  • The user menu opens profile, settings and sign-out.

Phone and small screens

  • The most important areas are available in the bottom navigation.
  • Open the menu for further areas and role-dependent functions.
  • Horizontal tab bars can be scrolled sideways.
  • A floating action button may provide the page’s primary action, such as creating an appointment.

Tabs within an area

Related pages use a tab bar. In match operations, for example, you can switch between Fixtures, My matchday, Help out, fussball.de import and Reports.

5. Check your profile and personal settings

  1. Open the user menu and select your profile.
  2. Check name, email and profile picture.
  3. Complete the offered information under Profile and Equipment.
  4. Check player and coach relationships through the chain icon in the profile header.
  5. Configure language, theme, push notifications and two-factor authentication under Settings.
  6. Save changed profile fields before closing the dialog.

6. Configure the dashboard

The dashboard combines quick actions and widgets. Select Add widget to include the calendar, messages, news, upcoming appointments, birthdays or a statistics widget.

Calendar entries, news, messages, attendance actions and reports can appear on the dashboard. See Dashboard for complete instructions.

Resolve initial problems

The password is not accepted

Check the email address and the password’s upper- and lower-case letters. Select Forgot password? if you are unsure of it. Repeated failed attempts can lock the account.

The account is locked

Follow the unlock link in the sign-in dialog, enter the requested email address and use the delivered link. If self-service unlocking is unavailable, contact the responsible administration.

An expected menu item is missing

  1. Reload and verify that you are using the correct account.
  2. Check the expected relationship in your profile.
  3. Check whether the assignment request has been approved.
  4. Compare your view with Help by role.
  5. Ask the responsible team or club administration to check the specific assignment.

A problem continues

Open My feedback and describe the step, expected result and visible message. Do not enter passwords, security codes or access credentials.
